blocks.body:
From Hardbrücke, walk down Geroldstrasse and turn left at the bakery: the salon is the dark shopfront with the round mirrors. Trams 4 and 13 stop at Quellenstrasse, two minutes away.

There is a bike rack outside and a ramp at the door. Parking on the street is blue zone; the Hardbrücke garage is the sure thing on a Saturday.
blocks.lead: Six minutes on foot from the station, on the quiet side of the street.
blocks.title: Josefstrasse, by Hardbrücke

blocks.lead: A question, a photograph of what you have in mind, or a day that is not in the diary yet. We answer within the day.
